This '''OOM security battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] at the time of the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

==Biography==
During the imprisonment of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] by the Separatists in the Citadel prison on Lola Sayu, this [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|Security droid]] along with many others were under command of prison warden, [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. When an elite team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived in the detention center and rescued Piell, they split up into two squads. The one led by Obi-Wan Kenobi was eventually captured by Sobeck and this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] along with a fellow one were tasked with escorting the prisoners to interrogation. Along the way, they were intercepted by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|battle droid squadron]], who were posing as confederate droids, and were requested to relinquish the prisoners to them. These droids complied and the prisoners were taken to the landing bay by R2's squad.

==Behind the scenes==
This droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
